Sizes are characters of the text the model receives (tokens are chars / 4, an estimate). The largest of System, Native tools, MCP tools and Messages is bold; each agent's `sizes.md` ranks every section, tool and message and lists sentences repeated across its context.

## Agents

- [`main/`](main/sizes.md): The session the user talks to: native tools, the Octocode MCP server, skills and project AGENTS.md.
- [`general/`](general/sizes.md): A subagent started without a role.
- [`researcher/`](researcher/sizes.md): A subagent started with the bundled `researcher` role.
- [`implementer/`](implementer/sizes.md): A subagent started with the bundled `implementer` role.
- [`reviewer/`](reviewer/sizes.md): A subagent started with the bundled `reviewer` role.
- [`browser/`](browser/sizes.md): A subagent started with the bundled `browser` role.
- [`lean/`](lean/sizes.md): A subagent started with the bundled `lean` role.

Each folder holds `system.md` (the whole system prompt), `tools.md` (every declaration with its parameter schema), `messages.md` (the conversation of the first request) and `sizes.md`.

## What is real

- The main session is the real session: the Octocode extension, the Octocode MCP server, bundled skills and a fixture `AGENTS.md`.
- A subagent is started as `subagents/tool.ts` starts one: its role prompt, identity, read-only and lean flags reach it through `subagentProcessEnv`, its tools, extensions and skills through `buildAgentArgs`, and its first message is built by `childTaskInput` and `withIdentity`. The parent's task text and the goal are placeholders.
- Paths, the date, platform, shell, ports and ids are replaced by fixed values so the files are the same on every machine.

## Update

After changing any prompt source, tool description or MCP preset, run `yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocodecode run generate:prompts`. The test fails while these files are stale.
